title: Jesus... Why Do I Hate Every Photo Of Myself?
topic: hating how she looks in every photo of herself

bible.text: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do I hate every photo of myself? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: My friend posted one tonight. I made her delete it.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I saw you zoom in on your face, looking for something wrong.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Because something is wrong. I'm not pretty like them.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You've compared yourself to filters so long, your real face feels like a mistake. It isn't.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I take pleasure in you. The same face you keep trying to hide.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to a friend who hates her own photos.
